changelog: Long recordings are no longer lost. A recording that took a long time to process could disappear without any error at all - and if the desktop hit a problem partway through transcribing one, it threw away the part it had already done. It now keeps every passage it managed to transcribe and tells you it was interrupted, so you can retry instead of starting from nothing. Long recordings also use far less memory while being transcribed, so a multi-hour meeting is much less likely to run your computer out of memory.
